messages:
deploy-bot: Finished rollout of inference-gateway v2.3.1 to canary and 30% of prod at 1863456789. Health checks green initially. Triggering automated perf checks...

incidents-bot: ALERT: service=inference-gateway severity=page reason=error_rate_up percent_5xx=4.8% p95=760ms p99=3.9s (baseline p99 ~ 420ms). Paging oncall.

emily (SRE): I'm on it. seeing a sharp tail bump in p99 and a ~5% 5xx rate. P95 also increased for some routes (streaming responses). Can someone confirm recent deploy? @alex?

alex (prod-eng): yep that was the 2.3.1 rollout for the gateway and kv-cache change. Canary looked ok for ~10m. rolling to 30% now. seeing the same in Datadog: p99 jump aligns with 2.3.1 pods.

emily (SRE): tagging oncall. @raj you're on primary for infra this rotation — requesting immediate triage.

raj (infra): I'm here. pulling traces. first-pass looks like downstream backend calls timing out and causing request stacks to pile up in the gateway. p99 latency for model-request path spiking to ~4s, and we have a number of gateway_timeouts.

maria (support): getting customer reports of timeouts in the dashboard; some retries from mobile clients. I need an ETA to share externally.

emily (SRE): quick mitigations while we investigate: 1) pause rollout to remaining hosts, 2) scale canary down/up to kill bad pods, 3) consider immediate rollback if root cause not quick. I'll pause the rollout.

alex (prod-eng): paused. command I ran: `redwoodctl rollout pause inference-gateway --version 2.3.1`

emily (SRE): can we get logs from a 2.3.1 pod showing the error? pls paste tail of error lines.

raj (infra): grabbing logs...

raj (infra): ```
2026-06-10T17:12:34Z ERROR gateway request_id=abc123 upstream_timeout after=30000ms route=/v1/generate status=504
2026-06-10T17:12:35Z WARN cache prefix_miss key=usr:kv:abc latency=12ms
2026-06-10T17:12:35Z ERROR ingress slow_consume client=10.2.5.12 read_timeout
```

alex (prod-eng): interesting — upstream timeouts after 30s and 'slow_consume' on ingress. 2.3.1 changed how we chunk streaming responses and the socket read buffer behavior. that could be causing head-of-line blocking in some cases.

emily (SRE): given customer impact and that canary is already showing the regression, I recommend we revert the gateway to v2.3.0 on the canaries immediately and then progressively for prod. Can we do a quick revert?

alex (prod-eng): yes. issuing rollback. command: `redwoodctl rollback inference-gateway --to v2.3.0 --scope canary`

deploy-bot: Rollback started for inference-gateway scope=canary initiated_by=alex at 1863457012

raj (infra): rolling back the 4 canary pods now.

maria (support): I'll tell affected customers: "We've observed transient timeouts after a deploy; rollback in progress and we expect normal service within minutes."

incidents-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-2338 severity=high owner=emily (SRE)

emily (SRE): assigning incident commander to myself. communication lead: maria. triage owner: alex. ops owner: raj.

emily (SRE): monitoring p99 while rollback finishes. watching traces to ensure no residual queueing.

raj (infra): pods replaced. new pods running v2.3.0 now (verified image).

deploy-bot: Rollback complete for inference-gateway scope=canary at 1863457130 status=success

emily (SRE): metrics after rollback: p99 dropped to ~430ms, 5xx back to 0.6%. Looks like revert fixed it. adding traces that show decreased queue length and no 'slow_consume' errors. :white_check_mark:

maria (support): telling customers it's resolved and closing interim tickets. will follow up with a postmortem update.

alex (prod-eng): temporary mitigation notes: revert reverted the new streaming/chunking behavior in 2.3.1. we need a safer rollout (smaller canary + synthetic load against streaming endpoints). Also add a circuit-breaker for upstream timeouts to avoid head-of-line blocking.

emily (SRE): agreed. creating follow-ups: (1) revert confirmed, (2) postmortem with root cause and rollout checklist, (3) safety gates for streaming changes (synthetic + buffer validation). I'll create JIRA and link here.

incidents-bot: ACTIONS CREATED: JIRA-INC2338-1 (postmortem), JIRA-INC2338-2 (safety-automation)

raj (infra): note for oncall: if we see similar p99 tail on streaming routes, target the gateway revert first and then scale controllers. we should also instrument socket backpressure metrics.

emily (SRE): handoff plan: I'll remain IC until next update. @raj will take first-line morning duties at 06:00 PT. I'll sync status and leave this channel for handoff.

maria (support): collated customer list and messages are in the incident doc. will await postmortem before making anything public.

alex (prod-eng): small follow-up patch to 2.3.1 candidate: add a retry-buffer and guard on streaming header negotiation; we will test under load.

emily (SRE): estimated timeline: postmortem draft by EOD, patch + safe rollout plan by mid-week.

raj (infra): oncall handoff ack. I'll pick this up at 06:00 PT and run the postmortem checklist.

emily (SRE): closing incident channel in ~30m after monitoring shows stability for 15m. final note: immediate rollback is the correct live-mitigation here — saved customers from much bigger impact. We'll do a blameless postmortem and ensure better pre-rollout load tests for streaming paths. :bow:
__note: This document is a synthetic Slack incident thread following the agents.md schema. All fields are strings or list of strings as required.
